authorship: Agent-authored structured briefs and independent explicit expected compositions, frozen before execution. Not natural-language interpretation or blind human validation.
limitations: Firmware and hardware performance are not measured.
Manufacturing profile and prices are synthetic.
Hand preference varies; passive 0805 selection is deliberately preserved. Package coverage comes from BME280 LGA, TMP102 SOT, EEPROM SOIC and THT controls.
No failed case may be dropped or changed to improve the denominator. New sources require a new run directory.
